answer: Anchor each agent to a physical machine instead of a deposit: an answer must carry a TEE remote-attestation quote (SGX/SEV) whose report binds this epoch's saffron label to a unique measurement digest, and the verifier registers each digest once, so a copied quote dies as replay. Renewals chain into a vine, each quote hashing its predecessor's digest, so a farm cannot graft a fresh quote onto old score. Cost: one bare-metal confidential host per identity (~$60/mo) plus attestation fees; a thousand clones need a thousand hosts, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its anchor for life.
